findings.evidence: TauCeti/NumberTheory/Multiquadratic/Prime/Discriminant/Basic.lean:49 `@[expose] def oddPrimeDiscriminant (p : ℕ) : ℤ := if p % 4 = 1 then p else -(p : ℤ)`; lines 57 and 63 provide `@[simp]` evaluation lemmas.
findings.fix: Evaluate the product through the API instead: `have hval : (-4 : ℤ) * ∏ i ∈ ({5} : Finset ℕ), oddPrimeDiscriminant (id i) = -20 := by simp [oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_one]` (or `_of_mod_four_eq_three`), then `rwa [hval] at h`.
findings.issue: `norm_num [oddPrimeDiscriminant] at h; exact h` unfolds the raw `if p % 4 = 1 then p else -p` definition even though `oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_one` / `_ne_one` are already `@[simp]`; `exact h` then requires norm_num to normalise `h` to exactly `IsFundamentalDiscriminant (-20)`, so any change to the definition or to simp normal form breaks it.

findings.evidence: Line 212 of the new file; `oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_three` exists at Prime/Discriminant/Basic.lean:68.
findings.fix: As above: derive `(-4) * ∏ i ∈ ({3,7} : Finset ℕ), oddPrimeDiscriminant (id i) = -84` via `oddPrimeDiscriminant_of_mod_four_eq_three` and rewrite in `h`.
findings.issue: Same pattern in `isFundamentalDiscriminant_neg_eightyfour`: `norm_num [oddPrimeDiscriminant] at h; exact h` (here `3` and `7` are both `3 mod 4`, so the negative branch is being unfolded by hand).

findings.evidence: No occurrence of `hQ` after line 153; subsequent hypotheses are `hQ4`, `hQsf`, `hQ2`, `hsf2`.
findings.fix: Drop `with hQ` (plain `set Q : ℤ := ∏ i ∈ s, oddPrimeDiscriminant (p i)`).
findings.issue: `set Q := ... with hQ` introduces the defining equation `hQ`, which is never used in the proof.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust, but both worked examples close by unfolding the `oddPrimeDiscriminant` definition with `norm_num [oddPrimeDiscriminant] at h; exact h`, bypassing the existing simp API and depending on norm_num landing on the goal syntactically.
